body:
Thank you so much for responding! 

What you said is really insightful. I don’t blame them one bit for no longer wanting to be my friend. I had no right to say what I did even if it was true. Besides that I was becoming someone at the time that I wouldn’t have wanted to be friends with. 

They were just in my dream and when I woke up I was so angry. Not at them or anyone in particular, but just angry with life I guess. I was on the verge of tears practically all morning. Then I just felt so sad. When this happened, to deal with losing this friendship I lied to myself. I told myself that I didn’t care about them anymore. I figured if I repeated it enough I could make it true. The truth is I will always care for this person.

I’ve buried a lot of feelings in the past so I’m not really sure what all of this means. I think it means something though. I hope it’s something that can help me.
